text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Let us begin the review session 
immediately. We'll analyze everything step 
by step, right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Is the recording ready yet? I need to 
review how the race unfolded... and check 
my form too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My strength wasn't enough this time, 
but... I have to turn this defeat into a 
stepping stone for the next.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"We won't stop here. The promise we made 
that day... we will definitely fulfill 
it."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Faster, stronger. I have to surpass who I 
am right now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That scenery is... way further ahead than 
where we are right now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Until that promise is fulfilled... let's 
keep moving forward!
